Let \(P(t)=\left(-\frac32 t^2,-3t\right)\). Then \(F=\left(-\frac32,0\right)\), so
\[
\overrightarrow{FP(t)}=\left(\frac32(1-t^2),-3t\right).
\]
Let \(M=P(t_1), N=P(t_2)\). From \(\overrightarrow{FM}=k\overrightarrow{FN}\),
\[
t_1=kt_2,\qquad 1-t_1^2=k(1-t_2^2).
\]
Substituting \(t_1=kt_2\) gives
\[
1-k^2t_2^2=k-kt_2^2 \implies t_2^2=-\frac1k,
\]
so \(k<0\) for distinct points.

The distance is
\[
|MN|=\frac32 |t_1-t_2|\sqrt{4+(t_1+t_2)^2}.
\]
Using \(t_1=kt_2\) and \(t_2^2=-1/k\),
\[
|MN|^2=\frac{9(k-1)^4}{4k^2},
\]
so
\[
|MN|=\frac32\frac{(k-1)^2}{|k|}.
\]
Let \(u=-k>0\). Then
\[
|MN|=\frac32\frac{(u+1)^2}{u}
=\frac32\left(u+2+\frac1u\right)\ge 6,
\]
with equality when \(u=1\), i.e. \(k=-1\).

\[
\boxed{6}
\]
